name: Harrell's Metal Works
old_description: At Harrell's Metal Works, Inc., we are committed to providing services that are Consistent, Reliable, and Cost-Effective.  We provide the highest Quality fabricated structural steel that meets or exceeds expectations for your project.
about:
Harrell's Metal Works, Inc., a family-owned business, was founded in 1985 in Grenada, Mississippi, by Randy Harrell. The company began serving the ornamental iron and miscellaneous metal industries before expanding into structural steel fabrication. Over the years, the business grew from ornamental iron work into a significant structural steel fabricator.

Today, the firm operates as a full-service structural fabrication shop specializing in subcontracted work. It produces fabricated structural steel for a range of projects, leveraging a team of dedicated employees under the leadership of Randy Harrell as owner and president, joined by his son Hunter Harrell as vice president and daughter Haley Harrell Moak.

The company serves contractors and project owners in the ornamental iron, miscellaneous metal, and structural steel sectors, providing subcontracted fabrication services for commercial and industrial construction projects.

Harrell's Metal Works emphasizes consistent, reliable, and cost-effective service, aiming to deliver the highest-quality fabricated structural steel that meets or exceeds project expectations.
